95% of THC is absorbed in the first few seconds

Yeah that's right! I remember someone telling me about this study a while ago and it kinda made sense because when we breath at a usual pace we exhale as quickly as we inhale.

Whenever this comes up, people mention that study which found that THC is almost immediately and fully absorbed by the lungs. I don't believe it, and I have good reason not to.

Back in the day, it used to be common to do what we called 'shotgunning' - you'd hang out with your girlfriend, and one of you would take a nice deep drag, and exhale it slowly through a paper tube for the other to inhale. It was a nice intimate thing to do and it got the recipient stoned as fuck. So I don't believe that everything is absorbed right away.

I'm not anti-science by any means, but I recognize that any unrepeated study ought to be regarded with some skepticism. The truth is that initial findings are often incomplete, or just plain wrong. It happens all the time.

My habit is to hold each drag for a long as is comfortable, and usually I exhale slowly through my nose. It's a nice relaxing habit and it makes me feel like I'm not wasting anything.
